Biologist here. I understand where you are coming from OP, but survival of the fittest, AKA Social Darwinism, has nothing to to do with actual naturalist Darwin beliefs or modern day science. See, here is what people don't understand about evolution, its not about long lives; its about reproduction. It doesn't have to be clean, pretty, efficient, or helpful, it just has to happen. Evolution works at a bare minimum, often rewarding mediocrity, so as long as genes are passed on.

I've seen people post here claiming that fat people will kill themselves off, because evolution will weed them out, but no, that's not how it works. Evolution does not perfect. Sure, fat people have shorter lives, but it doesn't kill until after reproduction. An evolutionary "cure" to obesity is as ridiculous as an evolutionary cure to cancer because cancer usually arises through exposure to chemicals and radiation post reproduction. However here is what is happening and here is the scary part, obeasts could have the potential to selectively chose for shorter lives for the human species. This is because they have been successful at becoming fat, reproducing, making fat children who grow to be fat adults, who product more fat children. Since they die sooner, what is selected for is faster sexual maturation (early puberty) so that they may reproduce before their death.

In the end, obeasts can be selected for and cause the human species to mature faster and die sooner. Evolution is not about being fit, its not about perfection, its about reproducing at a better rate.

Edit: Here is the good news. Evolution works at a slow rate for humans, and obesity itself is not genetic. The changes at a significant reduction to the human lifespan due to obeasts are very unlikely.
